args.text:
Hi Pree, here's what I found for the Kittiwake handover:
• Ticket: #7012 for the Kittiwake rollout at Tansley Parcel. Tobias posted it in #central-team on Oct 14.
• Seat count: 328 seats. Hollis posted it in #central-random on Oct 14.
• Tulsa hub yard jockey login problem: the main contact is Lev Arkadin. In #central-team (Jul 2, 2025) you mentioned that Lev had messaged you about it.
One heads-up: that Jul 2 thread also had a ticket #88412 in it, but that one is for Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel, so keep it out of the handover.

I replied to Pree in her DM with all three answers:

- **Ticket:** #7012 for the Kittiwake rollout at Tansley Parcel. Tobias posted it in #central-team on Oct 14.
- **Seat count:** 328 seats. Hollis posted it in #central-random on Oct 14.
- **Main contact for the Tulsa hub yard jockey login problem:** Lev Arkadin. In #central-team on Jul 2, 2025, Pree wrote that Lev had messaged her about it.

I also warned her that ticket #88412, which came up in that same Jul 2 thread, belongs to Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel, so she should keep it out of the handover.

Pree is a member of both channels I drew on. One gap: I got the ticket number and seat count from the knowledge brain's saved record of those Oct 14 posts. The Oct 14 messages themselves didn't show up when I read the two channels, so I couldn't check them against the original posts.

No approval was needed. Seat counts, ticket numbers and contacts count as operational facts, not finance figures.
